IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.databases WHERE name = 'advw')
BEGIN
    CREATE DATABASE [advw];
END;
GO

USE [advw];
GO

-- Customer
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Dim_Customer] AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'customer/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Customer];
GO

-- Product
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Dim_Product] AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'product/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Product];
GO

-- Product Category
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Dim_ProductCategory] AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'productcategory/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [ProductCat];
GO

-- Product SubCategory
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Dim_ProductSubCategory] AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'productsubcategory/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [ProductSubCat];
GO

-- Territories
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Dim_Territories] AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'territories/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Territories];
GO

-- Calendar
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Dim_Calendar] AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'calender/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Calendar];
GO

-- Returns
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Fact_Returns] AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'returns/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Returns];
GO

-- Unified Sales Fact View (Combines 2015, 2016, 2017)
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Fact_Sales] AS
SELECT *, 2015 AS SalesYear FROM OPENROWSET(BULK 'sales2015/', DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData', FORMAT = 'PARQUET') AS [S15]
UNION ALL
SELECT *, 2016 AS SalesYear FROM OPENROWSET(BULK 'sales2016/', DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData', FORMAT = 'PARQUET') AS [S16]
UNION ALL
SELECT *, 2017 AS SalesYear FROM OPENROWSET(BULK 'sales2017/', DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData', FORMAT = 'PARQUET') AS [S17];
GO
